courses.title: ToolTest 6 - Scale Body
courses.objective: Scale a selected body non-uniformly and uniformly, then validate its transformed dimensions and editability.

steps.title: Create measured body
steps.instructions: Create a body with known unequal X/Y/Z dimensions.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Non-uniform scale
steps.instructions: Scale the body differently along each axis.
steps.expectedResult: The body changes independently along X, Y and Z.

checkpoint.expected: The body changes independently along X, Y and Z.

validationChecks: Result dimensions reflect the per-axis factors
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Uniform scale
steps.instructions: Apply a uniform scale to the reference body.
steps.expectedResult: Every linear dimension increases by the same factor.

checkpoint.expected: Every linear dimension increases by the same factor.

validationChecks: All three dimensions use the same factor
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Edit scale
steps.instructions: Change one scale factor and regenerate.
steps.expectedResult: The scaled result updates without recreation.

checkpoint.expected: The scaled result updates without recreation.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.
